name: hcapp_getResetCode
description: Looks up a user's invite/reset code (URC: prefix) from their support code (USC: prefix). Intended for support staff to retrieve a user's invite code using the code on their profile. Returns the reset code or a 'Support code not found' string — both in the same column.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID. Used to look up caller's userId and device credentials.

parameters.name: supportCode
parameters.description: The USC:-prefixed support code to look up.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(1000) vs Hasher.SupportCode NVARCHAR(50) — parameter is 20× wider than column.

rowsets.name: NullUserError
rowsets.description: Returned when the device lookup yields no userId. Non-standard error format.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 fails. Non-standard error format.

rowsets.name: LookupResult
rowsets.description: Always returned on success. Contains either the reset code or the literal string 'Support code not found' — caller must check the value to distinguish.

columns.name: result
columns.description: The URC: reset code if found and user not removed, otherwise 'Support code not found'.

codeSmells.detail: Error rowsets use Pascal-cased column names (ErrorType, ErrorTitle, ErrorDescription) with no errorId or errorProc. Inconsistent with standard SP contract.

codeSmells.issue: Success/failure encoded as string value in result column
codeSmells.detail: Caller cannot distinguish 'found' from 'not found' by rowset structure — must parse the string value. 'Support code not found' should be an error rowset.
Parameter is 20× wider than the column. Should be aligned to NVARCHAR(50).

codeSmells.issue: EXISTS check and SELECT have inconsistent filters
codeSmells.detail: The EXISTS check finds the support code regardless of Removed status, then the SELECT filters on removed=0. A removed user's support code 'exists' but returns no rows, so @result stays 'Support code not found'. Technically safe but confusing.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the 'Support code not found' sentinel string without updating all callers
